full_judgment: 9. It is now a well settled provision of law is that by exercising the power conferred under section 115 of the Code of Civil Procedure this Court cannot go into the factual aspect even if in a case of reversal of judgment. On perusal of the judgment passed by the Court below it appears that both the Court below on vivid discussion of the evidence came to a clear finding in support of the opposite party regarding the question of limitation. Since there is no misreading of evidence so far it relates to limitation effecting the ultimate decision of the Courts below, I am of the view that the concurrent finding arrived at by the Courts below on question of limitation requires no interference by this Court.
